plans.note: Only the preamble is exposed in the outline, so the operative body must be read in full. A Master Services Agreement of this type almost always carries a limitation of liability article (typically paired with a disclaimer of consequential damages) in the later general-terms block; check mutuality of the cap, the cap metric (fees paid/payable over a trailing period) and carve-outs for indemnity, confidentiality, IP infringement and willful misconduct.

Expect a Kubient-side indemnity for third-party IP infringement and its own negligence/misconduct in the general terms, likely adjacent to the liability cap. Confirm AP's reciprocal indemnity is limited to AP-supplied content/data and does not sweep in general breach; if no vendor indemnity appears anywhere in the body, treat as missing.

Restrictive covenants limiting the customer's own business lines are unusual in an ad-tech MSA and none is signalled by the outline. Still scan any 'Exclusivity', 'Restrictions' or platform-use provisions before concluding absence.

No exclusivity heading is visible. Watch for a buried 'sole and exclusive provider' or 'all inventory shall be routed through' sentence in the services/scope or order-form language, which would bind AP's supply freedom.

MFN language is not indicated in the outline. If pricing terms appear in a fee schedule or order form, check the direction: an MFN running in AP's favour is acceptable and should not be flagged; only an obligation on AP to extend best terms to Kubient is a deviation.

Mutual or one-way non-solicitation clauses commonly sit near confidentiality or in the miscellaneous block of an MSA. Assess duration (12 months preferred), whether it binds AP at all, and whether general advertising / unsolicited applicants are carved out.

The defined term 'Initial Term' confirms a term-and-termination article exists in the body. Check whether AP can terminate for convenience on notice without penalty or early-termination fees, and whether Kubient holds a symmetrical mid-term convenience right that we should strip or lengthen.

'Initial Term' strongly implies a renewal mechanic in the same term article. Review the non-renewal notice window (30-60 days preferred, not 90+), whether renewal is automatic, and any uncapped price uplift on renewal (a missing uplift cap is a rationale note, not a standalone deviation).

Governing law and venue will sit in the miscellaneous/general provisions at the end. Both parties are New York-based on the face of the preamble, so New York law and New York courts are the expected and acceptable outcome; flag only foreign law or mandatory offshore arbitration.

Look in the miscellaneous block for an assignment clause. Confirm AP may assign to affiliates and to a successor by merger or asset sale without consent, and that Kubient has no right to terminate on AP's change of control.

An intellectual property / ownership article is standard in this MSA type and is critical here given AP content and audience data flowing through Kubient's platform. Verify AP retains ownership of its content, Customer Data and deliverables paid for, and that any licence to Kubient is limited to performing the services (no ownership transfer, no broad data-monetisation right).

Check the platform/services access grant, likely in the scope or IP article. Confirm the licence extends to AP affiliates and contractors acting on AP's behalf and is not revocable at Kubient's discretion outside a termination event.

Audit language may appear either as a vendor right to verify AP's usage or as AP's right to verify reporting and fees. Only vendor-side audits of our usage are in scope for this rule: test frequency (annual), advance notice, off-site/remote conduct, business hours, and that Kubient bears its own cost absent material underpayment.

No SLA or damages schedule is visible in the outline. If a service-level or fees exhibit exists, credits running to AP are beneficial and should not be flagged; only liquidated damages or penalty amounts payable by AP would be a deviation.

Expect a representations and warranties article, often immediately followed by a disclaimer. Confirm Kubient warrants professional, workmanlike performance and conformity to spec for a meaningful period with re-performance or refund as the remedy, and that an 'AS IS' disclaimer does not swallow the warranty.

Insurance covenants are frequently omitted from short-form platform MSAs and none is signalled here. Kubient handles AP data, so if no insurance article (commercial general liability, tech E&O/cyber, workers' comp) appears in the body or an exhibit, treat as missing and propose standard limits.

No fees or commitment section is exposed. Check any order form, insertion order or fee schedule for minimum spend, minimum impression volumes or take-or-pay language binding AP, and whether an exit or true-down exists.

Look for effects-of-termination / survival language within the term and termination article. Confirm AP receives return or export of its data in a usable format and reasonable wind-down assistance; if the clause only addresses fee acceleration and deletion, treat the transition obligation as missing.
